text:
incident-bot: Pager: Elevated 5xx and timeouts from inference-runtime group 'model-runner' in us-west-2. 35% error rate over last 3m. Affected route: /v1/generate. Incident ID: INC-20260317-01
jamie_oncall: acked. I'm oncall — starting triage. Anyone see related deploys?
alice.sr: no deploys in last hour. Kernel OOM patterns previously from KV cache growth.
devin_ml: seeing spikes in host memory on metrics -> model runner processes memory climb, then segfaults in liveness logs.
jamie_oncall: can we confirm customer impact? tara_prod?
tara_prod: p50 latency up 2x, some 502s surfaced to customers on premium routes. Support getting 6 tickets.
kyle_support: forwarding a couple customer snippets, they saw 'upstream error 502' and timeouts.
jamie_oncall: ok. immediate mitigation: 1) scale up pool by +2 nodes 2) route traffic away from us-west-2 to us-east-1 fallback 3) disable quantized kernels for the problematic model 4) enable fast-fallback to smaller model variant.
alice.sr: running autoscale now, +2 nodes queued. I'll start rerouting via traffic-router: runbook step 3
jamie_oncall: devin, can you trigger rollout of fallback model variant with weight 20%?
devin_ml: doing rollout, will wire fallback and watch for error drop. starting at 20% -> 50% over 5m
alice.sr: I see one infer node with repeated segfaults -> collecting core + /var/log/model-runner/stacktrace.log
jamie_oncall: good. if core present, capture and paste stacktrace snippet
alice.sr: stacktrace: "SIGSEGV at 0x7f... in attention_kernel.c: line 423". Heap growth before crash.
jamie_oncall: probable mem leak under certain request shapes. For live mitigation keep fallback ramping and drain failing hosts.
tara_prod: ramping fallback now, customers reporting fewer 502s in samples.
kyle_support: will update support tickets with mitigation note: routing to fallback, investigating root cause.
jamie_oncall: next steps: collect core dumps + kvcache stats, open a postmortem. Devin/Alice to own root cause. I'll keep paging until stable.
incident-bot: Note: incident status changed to MITIGATED -> monitoring. Escalation remains open until postmortem.
jamie_oncall: thanks team. will document timeline and hand off to next oncall at 0200 UTC.
